   8 func register(entity_id: String, entity_name: String, components: Array, placement: Variant = null) -> GameEntity:
   9 	var entity := GameEntity.new()
  10 	entity.id = entity_id
  11 	entity.name = entity_name
  12 	runtime.world.add_entity(entity, components)
  13 	if placement is Vector2:
  14 		runtime.request_placement(entity_id, placement)
  15 	return entity

  58 func create_prop(room_id: String, record: Dictionary) -> GameEntity:
  59 	var visual := C_Visual.new()
  60 	visual.asset_id = record.asset_id
  61 	visual.draw_size = Vector2(record.size[0], record.size[1])
  62 	visual.z_index = int(record.get("z", 0))
  63 	var member := C_RoomMember.new()
  64 	member.room_id = room_id
  65 	return register(room_id + ":" + record.id, record.id, [C_Transform.new(), C_Body.new(), visual, member], Vector2(record.position[0], record.position[1]))

  67 func create_room(room: Dictionary) -> void:
  68 	var bounds: Array = room.bounds
  69 	if float(bounds[3]) > 720.0:
  70 		# Tall rooms use one aspect-preserving plate; the illustrated art is not tileable.
  71 		var texture: Texture2D = runtime.resources.resolve(room.background)
  72 		var factor: float = maxf(float(bounds[2]) / texture.get_width(), float(bounds[3]) / texture.get_height())
  73 		var dimensions: Vector2 = texture.get_size() * factor
  74 		var background := create_prop(room.id, {"id": "background_0_0", "asset_id": room.background, "position": [bounds[0] + bounds[2] / 2.0, bounds[1] + bounds[3] / 2.0], "size": [dimensions.x, dimensions.y], "z": -100})
  75 		background.get_component(C_Visual).tint = Color(room.light[0], room.light[1], room.light[2], room.light[3])
  76 	else:
  77 		var plate_count: int = ceili(float(bounds[2]) / 1280.0)
  78 		for i in plate_count:
  79 			var background := create_prop(room.id, {"id": "background_%d_0" % i, "asset_id": room.background, "position": [bounds[0] + 640 + i * 1280, bounds[1] + 360], "size": [1280, 720], "z": -100})
  80 			background.get_component(C_Visual).tint = Color(room.light[0], room.light[1], room.light[2], room.light[3])
  81 	for record in room.platforms:
  82 		create_platform(room.id, record)
  83 	for record in room.props:
  84 		create_prop(room.id, record)
  85 	for record in room.get("enemies", []):
  86 		create_enemy(room.id, record)
  87 	for record in room.doors:
  88 		create_interaction(room.id, record, "door")
  89 	if room.get("relic") != null and not runtime.progression.moonstep:
  90 		create_interaction(room.id, room.relic, "relic")
  91 	if room.get("checkpoint") != null:
  92 		create_interaction(room.id, room.checkpoint, "checkpoint")
  93 	if room.get("boss") != null and not runtime.progression.boss_defeated:
  94 		create_boss(room.id, room.boss)
  95 
  96 func create_interaction(room_id: String, record: Dictionary, kind: String) -> GameEntity:
  97 	var visual := C_Visual.new()
  98 	visual.asset_id = "arch" if kind == "door" else ("moonstep" if kind == "relic" else "shrine")
  99 	visual.draw_size = Vector2(240, 360) if kind == "door" else (Vector2(48, 48) if kind == "relic" else Vector2(180, 180))
 100 	visual.offset.y = -visual.draw_size.y * 0.5
 101 	visual.z_index = -4 if kind == "door" else 12
 102 	var interaction := C_Interaction.new()
 103 	interaction.kind = kind
 104 	interaction.interaction_id = record.id
 105 	interaction.prompt = record.prompt
 106 	interaction.target_room = record.get("target_room", "")
 107 	interaction.target_spawn = record.get("target_spawn", record.get("spawn_id", ""))
 108 	var member := C_RoomMember.new()
 109 	member.room_id = room_id
 110 	return register(room_id + ":" + record.id, record.id, [C_Transform.new(), C_Body.new(), visual, member, interaction], Vector2(record.position[0], record.position[1]))

 184 func create_transient(archetype: String, room_id: String, fields: Dictionary) -> GameEntity:
 185 	var member := C_RoomMember.new()
 186 	member.room_id = room_id
 187 	var components: Array = [C_Transform.new(), member]
 188 	if archetype == "projectile":
 189 		var projectile := C_Projectile.new()
 190 		projectile.owner_id = fields.owner_id
 191 		projectile.team = fields.team
 192 		projectile.direction = fields.direction
 193 		projectile.speed = fields.get("speed", 660.0)
 194 		projectile.damage = fields.get("damage", 20)
 195 		projectile.remaining = fields.get("remaining", 2.0)
 196 		var motion := C_Motion.new()
 197 		motion.gravity = 0.0
 198 		var body := C_Body.new()
 199 		body.kind = "character"
 200 		body.size = Vector2(18, 28)
 201 		body.offset = Vector2.ZERO
 202 		body.layer = 8 if projectile.team == "player" else 16
 203 		body.mask = 1 | (4 if projectile.team == "player" else 2)
 204 		var visual := C_Visual.new()
 205 		visual.asset_id = "player_card" if projectile.team == "player" else "enemy_card"
 206 		visual.draw_size = Vector2(24, 36) if projectile.team == "player" else Vector2(28, 42)
 207 		visual.z_index = 25
 208 		components.append_array([projectile, motion, body, visual])
 209 	elif archetype == "hitbox":
 210 		var hitbox := C_Hitbox.new()
 211 		hitbox.owner_id = fields.owner_id
 212 		hitbox.team = fields.team
 213 		hitbox.attack_serial = fields.attack_serial
 214 		hitbox.offset = fields.get("offset", hitbox.offset)
 215 		hitbox.size = fields.get("size", hitbox.size)
 216 		hitbox.damage = fields.get("damage", hitbox.damage)
 217 		hitbox.active_left = fields.get("active_left", hitbox.active_left)
 218 		hitbox.follows_owner = fields.get("follows_owner", true)
 219 		components.append(hitbox)
 220 	elif archetype == "effect":
 221 		var effect := C_Effect.new()
 222 		effect.kind = fields.get("kind", "impact")
 223 		effect.duration = fields.get("duration", 0.25)
 224 		effect.remaining = effect.duration
 225 		effect.size = fields.get("size", Vector2(32, 32))
 226 		effect.color = fields.get("color", Color.WHITE)
 227 		effect.owner_id = fields.get("owner_id", "")
 228 		var visual := C_Visual.new()
 229 		visual.kind = "sprite" if effect.kind == "ghost_hand" else "effect"
 230 		visual.asset_id = "ghost_hand" if effect.kind == "ghost_hand" else ""
 231 		visual.draw_size = effect.size
 232 		visual.tint = effect.color
 233 		visual.z_index = 30
 234 		components.append_array([effect, visual])
 235 	else:
 236 		runtime.fail("Unknown transient archetype: " + archetype)
 237 		return null
 238 	return register(fields.id, fields.id, components, fields.position)
